items.prompt: Explain to a classmate why knowing an algorithm's Big-O notation is important when choosing between two solutions for a large dataset.
items.reference_answer: Knowing the Big-O notation helps us understand how an algorithm's runtime will scale as the dataset gets larger. An algorithm with a better Big-O (e.g., O(n log n) vs. O(n^2)) will be significantly faster and more feasible for large datasets, preventing extremely long processing times. Final answer: Better Big-O means faster and more feasible performance.
